component.name: Cairo QML Clock
component.summary: A cairo-clock replacement built with Qt6 QML

description.p: A modern reimplementation of MacSlow's cairo-clock using Qt6 QML. Runs on modern Linux systems without deprecated dependencies.

ul.li: 30 themes organized in favorites, bundled, and custom folders
Frameless transparent window with drag support on X11 and Wayland
Right-click menu with Properties, Info, and Quit
Size presets and custom size via spinboxes
Show seconds, show date (European DD/MM format), 24-hour mode
Keep on top and sticky workspace (X11 and Wayland with XWayland)
Theme-aware hand colors with automatic correction

screenshot.caption: Three clock themes running on a Linux desktop

ul.li: Clock now appears on all workspaces on X11 and Wayland (with XWayland)
About dialog auto-sizes to fit content on all screen densities
Switched to io.github.rappel12 app ID for Flathub submission
Properties and Info dialogs are now movable on Wayland
Context menu dismisses on click-outside on both X11 and Wayland
GTK-friendly appearance on non-KDE desktops (Adwaita style)
Self-contained Flatpak — no host Qt6 required
